description:
A 3D artist has completed a car visualization render but the raw output looks flat. Set up a cinematic post-processing pipeline using Blender's Compositor:

1. Switch to the Compositing workspace and enable 'Use Nodes'
2. Add a Glare node (Filter > Glare) — set type to 'Fog Glow' or 'Streaks' with threshold ≤ 1.0
3. Add a Color Balance node (Color > Color Balance) — adjust for warm/cinematic toning
4. Add a Lens Distortion node (Distort > Lens Distortion) — set distortion between -0.05 and 0.1
5. Connect the nodes in a chain: Render Layers → Glare → Color Balance → Lens Distortion → Composite
6. Render the scene (the compositor will apply effects to the render)
7. Save the rendered composite image to /home/ga/BlenderProjects/cinematic_composite.png
8. Save the project file to /home/ga/BlenderProjects/compositing_setup.blend

The BMW car scene is already loaded with a camera and low render settings for quick rendering (32 samples, 50% resolution).
